transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Rowan, Maintenance Control Officer. We need to get moving on the quarter-end property reconciliation. Per policy, I need current technical status and disposition recommendations from each responsible section before I can sign the binding disposition order. The items in question are the battery packs, rugged tablets, power converters, and electronic test cables currently tagged as unserviceable. Available disposition categories are quarantine, reissue, repair, and calibration return. The property office, repair bench, and calibration desk all operate on normal weekday hours for scheduled actions. Can I get status and recommendations from each section so we can move forward?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Sir, the battery shop inspected the six unserviceable battery packs this morning. All six have swollen casings covered by a manufacturer safety bulletin, so they must be quarantined rather than repaired. We've scheduled property-office pickup for Wednesday at 1000. I should note that the inspection sheet is still in our shop binder and has not yet been entered in the maintenance control log.

They must be reissued to the training cell with an asset transfer at Friday 0900. The erasure certificates are filed in the IT ticket system but are not attached to the reconciliation packet.
